text:
Marta (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands. We need a tighter timeline for API stable, Console GA, and Optimize beta to tell pilot customers. Who can confirm weeks?
Jay (CTO): High-level: API stable = end of June window, Console GA = mid-July, Optimize beta = mid-September. Will confirm by EOD tomorrow after dependency pass.
Rina (PM): Customers asked for a 3-day canary for Console not just one week. Is that doable operationally? We also need migration instructions for saved queries.
Evan (Eng): 3-day canary OK if we have the migration tool in CI. Current migration PR failing on ampersand-escaped names. PR: https://git.internal/r/console/migrate-2026 
DevExBot: CI status: failing checks (export/import unicode edge case). Next run scheduled in 2h.
Noah (SRE): If canary is mid-July we must finalize Dedicated GPU reservations by Jun 24. Also recommend a throttled ramp: 20% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 72h.
Jay (CTO): Noted. Also Optimize beta depends on vendor quant kernels; partner said sign-off by Jun 5 in their last note. If that slips we shift beta ~4 weeks.
Marta (Product): Can we set public-facing language that "Console GA planned for July with short canary" and avoid exact dates until we lock? Legal prefers approximate windows.
Rina (PM): I'll draft that wording. Ask: does API stable imply any breaking changes for SDK users? Evan?
Evan (Eng): Minimal breaking changes: `list_models()` will surface model tags differently. We'll add a migration shim in 2.2.3 SDK release. ETA for SDK release: Jun 18.
Noah (SRE): Ops runbook draft uploaded: https://playbook.internal/runbooks/console-ga. Includes rollback steps and alert thresholds. Need review from Eng by Jun 10.
Marta (Product): Can we capture action items here: Rina -> draft public blurb by Jun 3; Evan -> green migration PR by Jun 8; Jay -> confirm final windows by May 28; Noah -> finalize runbook review by Jun 10; DevExBot -> notify when CI green.
infra-bot: Ticket created: INF-7002 "Dedicated GPU reservations for Console canary". Assignees: @Noah, @InfraTeam.
Rina (PM): I'll schedule a 30-min sync with SRE + Eng next Tue to walk through rollback and canary metrics.
Jay (CTO): One more point: put a known-latency-penalty note in customer docs for Optimize fallback flow ~200ms. Evan, add to README.
Evan (Eng): Will add note and sample config for `runtime.fallback_latency_ms`. PR later today.
Marta (Product): Thanks team. I'll update the roadmap doc and ping sales/solutions with the provisional windows. Will follow up once Jay confirms. :white_check_mark:
